## Littelfuse Reports Third Quarter Results for 2026


October, 28, 2026


Download (opens in new window)


**Third Quarter Highlights:** *(Year-over-year comparisons unless otherwise noted)*


- Record net sales of $767 million, including a reduction of $28.5 million related to a one-time Dortmund contract amendment fee recorded as a reduction of semiconductor net sales
- Organic growth contributed +22%
- Cash flow from operations of $230 million, +57%; Free cash flow of $216 million, +64%
- YTD cash flow from operations of $457 million, +55%; YTD free cash flow of $409 million, +66%
- GAAP diluted earnings per share of $4.49, +62%
- Record adjusted diluted earnings per share of $5.79, +96%
- GAAP operating margin of 20.0%, +440 bps; Adjusted EBITDA margin of 28.4%, +690 bps


CHICAGO--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Littelfuse, Inc. (NASDAQ: LFUS), a leader in developing smart solutions that enable safe and efficient electrical energy transfer, today reported financial results for its third quarter ended September 26, 2026:


“We delivered strong third quarter results reflecting broad-based demand strength, disciplined execution, and continued momentum across the portfolio,” said Greg Henderson, Littelfuse President and Chief Executive Officer. “Our teams drove significant growth across our segments, while delivering meaningful margin expansion and robust cash generation as we continued to advance our strategic priorities.”


“Looking ahead to the fourth quarter, we continue to see strong demand across our diverse market exposures, and we expect approximately +28% yr/yr revenue growth. We remain focused on scaling our high growth opportunities, partnering with our market leading customers, enhancing operational excellence, and deploying capital with discipline as we execute our long-term strategy.”


**Fourth Quarter of 2026***


Based on current market conditions, for the fourth quarter the Company expects:


- Net sales in the range of $750 - $770 million, adjusted diluted EPS in the range of $5.05 - $5.25 and an adjusted effective tax rate of approximately ~24%


**Littelfuse provides guidance on a non-GAAP (adjusted) basis. GAAP items excluded from guidance may include the after-tax* *impact of items including acquisition and integration costs, restructuring, impairment and other charges, certain purchase* *accounting adjustments, non-operating foreign exchange adjustments and significant and unusual items. These items are* *uncertain, depend on various factors, and could be material to results computed in accordance with GAAP. Accordingly,* *Littelfuse is not able to forecast the excluded items in order to provide the most directly comparable GAAP financial measure* *without unreasonable efforts.*


**Third Quarter 2026 Segment Performance Highlights**


*Electronics Segment*


- Net sales for the third quarter 2026 increased to $426 million, including the previously disclosed $28.5 million (€24.6 million) one-time Dortmund contract amendment fee recorded as a reduction of semiconductor net sales. Organic sales increased +27% driven by improved passive products (+30% organic). Semiconductor products (+24% organic) also contributed to growth driven by increased protection and power semiconductor volumes.


- Adjusted EBITDA margin for the third quarter 2026 increased to 33.1% (+910 bps) due to volume leverage, operational execution, and favorable price and product mix.


*Transportation Segment*


- Net sales for the third quarter 2026 increased +7%, both reported and organic, to $183 million. Organic sales growth benefited from improved commercial vehicle sales (+20% organic), which offset lower passenger vehicle organic sales (-5%). Commercial vehicle sales growth benefited from improved truck, data center, material handling, construction and agricultural equipment demand. Lower passenger vehicle sales were impacted by lower global passenger car builds and auto sensor product declines.


- Adjusted EBITDA margin for the third quarter 2026 increased to 19.6% (+280 bps) driven by commercial vehicle volume leverage and operational execution.


*Industrial Segment*


- Net sales for the third quarter 2026 increased +65% to $158 million. Organic sales increased +27% driven by improved data center, grid & utility infrastructure, HVAC, industrial automation, and construction demand. The Basler Electric Company (“Basler”) acquisition contributed +38% to growth.


- Adjusted EBITDA margin for the third quarter 2026 increased to 25.2% (+450 bps) driven by improved volume leverage, operational efficiencies, and favorable price and product mix.


**Dividend**


- The Company announced a quarterly cash dividend of $0.80 per share on its common stock. The dividend will be paid on December 3, 2026, to shareholders of record as of November 19, 2026.


**Conference Call and Webcast Information**


Littelfuse will host a conference call on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, at 8:00 a.m. Central Time to discuss the results. The call will be broadcast and available for replay at[Littelfuse.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.littelfuse.com%2F&esheet=54629902&newsitemid=20261028622201&lan=en-US&anchor=Littelfuse.com&index=1&md5=3a4bdb90cc18d4a0dfe478accf757b45) . A slide presentation will be available in the Investor Relations section of the Company’s website at[Littelfuse](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.littelfuse.com%2F&esheet=54629902&newsitemid=20261028622201&lan=en-US&anchor=Littelfuse&index=2&md5=1e78045c3f0965159795a95aed02a3b1) .com.


**About Littelfuse**


Littelfuse, Inc. (NASDAQ: LFUS) is a diversified, industrial technology manufacturing company empowering a sustainable, connected, and safer world. Across more than 20 countries, and with approximately 18,000 global associates, we partner with customers to design and deliver innovative, reliable solutions. Serving over 100,000 end customers, our products are found in a variety of industrial, transportation and electronics end markets – everywhere, every day. Learn more at[Littelfuse.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.littelfuse.com%2F&esheet=54629902&newsitemid=20261028622201&lan=en-US&anchor=Littelfuse.com&index=3&md5=bac459d92d83853690701bba42b556d1) .

***Non-GAAP Financial Measures***


The information included in this press release and other materials filed with the SEC may include non-GAAP financial measures including organic net sales (decline) growth, adjusted net sales, adjusted operating income, adjusted operating margin, adjusted EBITDA, adjusted EBITDA margin, adjusted diluted earnings per share, adjusted income taxes, adjusted effective tax rate, free cash flow, net debt, consolidated EBITDA, and consolidated net leverage ratio (as defined in the Credit Agreement). The Company believes that all of these non-GAAP financial measures are commonly used by financial analysts and others in the industries in which we operate, and thus further provide useful information to investors. Management additionally uses these measures when assessing the performance of the business and for business planning purposes.
